basic_details.scholarship_name: Sejong University International Graduate Scholarship & Research Assistantships
basic_details.offering_entity: Sejong University & Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Sejong University Main Campus (Gwangjin-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Department of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, Department of Intelligent Mechatronics Engineering, Department of Software, Department of Information Security, and Department of Aerospace Engineering.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~150 to 200 graduate scholarships and laboratory research assistantships awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally on merit; Pakistani graduate scholars have an exceptionally strong presence in Sejong's computing and AI research laboratories (~20 to 35 awards annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 years for Master's; 3 to 4 years for PhD
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: KRW 1,000,000 to 1,500,000 / month (approx. $750 to $1,120 / month; ~PKR 210,000 to 310,000 / month) laboratory living stipend plus 100% full tuition fee waiver

nationality_requirements: International applicants whose parents are both non-Korean citizens (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No upper age limit; evaluation based on academic GPA, programming skills, and research aptitude.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: 16-year Bachelor's degree with minimum cumulative GPA of 3.00 / 4.00 (or 75%+ marks) for Master's; 18-year Master's degree with minimum GPA 3.00 / 4.00 for PhD from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum undergraduate GPA of 3.0 / 4.0; 100% tuition waiver (Sejong Global Scholarship Class A) requires undergraduate GPA >= 3.5 / 4.0 or high English test score.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Computer science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, electronic engineering, mechatronics, or related quantitative field.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year students graduating before semester start date.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior scientific research publications, software coding projects, or machine learning expertise strongly valued.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.0 (6.5+ for top scholarship tier), TOEFL iBT minimum 80, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate accepted.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Korean language proficiency is NOT required for English-track STEM laboratories.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates typically secure agreement from a prospective laboratory professor (PI) prior to application to guarantee living stipend support.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Subject to university guidelines on concurrent award holding.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver awarded through Sejong Global Scholarship Class A or combined with professor laboratory tuition matching funds.
tuition_fee.amount: 100% covered (~KRW 6,500,000 to 7,500,000 / semester value; ~PKR 2,700,000 to 3,100,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: Non-refundable graduate application fee of KRW 120,000 (approx. USD 90 / ~PKR 25,000) paid online.

accommodation.details: On-campus international graduate dormitory (Happy Dormitory / Gwanggaeto Hall) or private studios (One-room / Goshiwon) near campus in Seoul funded via monthly stipend.
accommodation.amount: Funded from stipend (~KRW 350,000 to 550,000 / month rent)

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly research stipend of KRW 1,000,000 to 1,500,000 / month ($750 to $1,120 / month; ~PKR 210,000 to 310,000 / month) disbursed by the supervising professor's national research projects (BK21 Four / NRF).

airfare.details: International airfare to Incheon/Seoul is self-funded or subsidized by professor project travel funds upon arrival.

visa_fee.details: Korean D-2 Student Visa application fee (~$60 / ~PKR 17,000) paid directly to Korean Embassy in Islamabad or Consulate in Karachi.

health_insurance.details: Mandatory National Health Insurance Service (NHIS) coverage for international students in Korea (~KRW 70,000 / month; covers primary medical and dental care) funded from monthly stipend.
health_insurance.amount: Approx. KRW 70,000 / month borne from stipend

food_allowance.details: Campus cafeterias at Sejong offer high-quality meals for KRW 4,500 to 6,500 per meal; easily covered by monthly living stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Dedicated laboratory desk, GPU computing workstations (NVIDIA A100/H100 clusters for AI labs), and full university library access included.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Supervising professors fully fund international travel, registration, and hotel expenses for students presenting papers at international conferences (IEEE, ACM, CVPR, ICCV).
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Full conference travel funding provided by lab

travel_transit_allowance.details: Seoul Metropolitan Subway Line 7 connects directly to Children's Grand Park Station (Sejong University); transit funded independently via T-money card.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single leading private research university in Seoul (Sejong University).
participating_institutions: Sejong University Main Campus (Seoul, Republic of Korea)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Times Higher Education World University Rankings #251-300, Top 8 in South Korea, THE Asia #39; renowned for Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, and Hospitality Management.
available_majors: MSc / PhD in Computer Science and Engineering
MSc / PhD in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
MSc / PhD in Intelligent Mechatronics Engineering
MSc / PhD in Nanotechnology and Advanced Materials
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's / Master's degree with 3.0+ GPA, verified transcripts, IELTS 6.0+ / TOEFL 80+ or MOI certificate, prospective professor recommendation letter, statement of purpose, CV, and financial guarantee documents.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Securing an informal acceptance / sponsorship email from a Sejong laboratory professor (PI) prior to application is the essential step to ensure 100% tuition waiver and living stipend.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Browse Sejong faculty research labs in AI, Computer Vision, Cybersecurity, and Robotics; email professors with a tailored CV highlighting coding skills (PyTorch, TensorFlow, C++, ROS) and research publications.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Sejong University Online Graduate Application System (Uwayapply)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Contact prospective faculty professor in target laboratory, secure sponsorship commitment, register on Uwayapply, choose intended graduate department, complete online form, upload scanned credentials, and pay KRW 120,000 fee.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Identify faculty laboratory on Sejong website and contact professor with CV, transcripts, and research interests.
Step 2: Attend virtual interview with professor and obtain written agreement for laboratory research assistantship.
Step 3: Register on Uwayapply portal and complete Sejong graduate application form.
Step 4: Upload official academic transcripts, English score report, statement of purpose, and CV.
Step 5: Pay KRW 120,000 application fee online.
Step 6: Submit hard copies of notarized transcripts and degree apostilles to Sejong International Student Center by deadline.
Step 7: University admissions committee issues formal Certificate of Admission and scholarship letter.
Step 8: Apply for Korean D-2 Student Visa at Korean Embassy in Pakistan and travel to Seoul for registration.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Professor Sponsorship Track: Tuition waiver scholarship and laboratory research stipend are formulated concurrently based on professor recommendation.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted as official signed recommendation letters, including the Sejong professor's official departmental recommendation form.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Self-introduction and study plan detailing academic background, technical skills, reasons for choosing Sejong University, and target research goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured research plan (2 to 3 pages) outlining proposed research topic and alignment with the supervising laboratory.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic research CV detailing education, publications, conference presentations, programming languages, and software projects.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Technical video interview via Zoom with laboratory professor (PI) testing programming skills, algorithm knowledge, and research motivation.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.0+, TOEFL iBT 80+, or official English Medium of Instruction certificate accepted.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC and MoFA Pakistan verified degrees and transcripts, plus Apostille or Korean Embassy attestation.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Notarized English translation of all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via Uwayapply portal followed by postal submission of attested documents.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Bachelor's / Master's degree with minimum GPA 3.0 / 4.0 from an accredited university.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC, MoFA Pakistan, and Korean Embassy.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official recommendation and financial sponsorship confirmation from Sejong supervising professor.

IELTS Academic 6.0+, TOEFL iBT 80+, or official English Medium of Instruction certificate.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Biannual admissions: Spring intake (starts March) and Fall intake (starts September).

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 30% (Academic transcript GPA, coursework grades in core technical subjects)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 45% (Prior research publications, coding projects, laboratory PI sponsorship)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Industry software engineering or research lab experience)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Departmental Faculty Admissions Committee, Laboratory Principal Investigators (PIs), and Graduate School Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Holistic review prioritizing laboratory research match, programming capability, prior publications, and supervising professor's endorsement.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~2,000 to 3,000 international applicants across graduate faculties
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~150 to 200 fully funded graduate research positions annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~8.0% to 12.0% for applicants who secure professor sponsorship and have strong coding/publication records
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Undergraduate CGPA >= 3.30 / 4.00, accompanied by strong coding portfolio (GitHub) or research publications
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates holding strong bachelor's or master's degrees in CS/Engineering with demonstrated machine learning, software development, or research skills.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from Pakistani engineering and computing institutions (NUST, FAST-NUCES, COMSATS, UET, GIKI, Quaid-i-Azam, PIEAS).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Vietnam, India, Bangladesh, China, Indonesia, Nepal, Uzbekistan, Turkey.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official Sejong portal at sejong.ac.kr and uwayapply.com.
Beware of unauthorized recruitment agencies charging exorbitant placement fees; always contact professors directly.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee of KRW 120,000 is paid directly via Uwayapply; no extra agent fees required.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Commercial agencies cannot guarantee admission or lab stipends; professors make autonomous decisions.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Korean D-2 Visa fee in Pakistan: ~PKR 17,000.
Notarization, HEC/MoFA, and Korean Embassy attestations: ~PKR 30,000 to 45,000.
Initial dormitory security deposit in Seoul: ~KRW 300,000 (~PKR 62,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You need TOPIK Korean scores to study at Sejong. Reality: STEM graduate labs operate 100% in English; TOPIK is not required.
Myth: You can get fully funded without contacting a professor. Reality: Getting professor sponsorship before applying is essential to guarantee monthly laboratory living stipends.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party sites frequently quote outdated stipend values; current verified laboratory stipends range from KRW 1,000,000 to 1,500,000 per month.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative graduate GPA of 3.0 / 4.0 throughout each semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time resident study in Seoul and active daily participation in laboratory research duties.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-end academic review and research milestone presentations evaluated by the supervising professor.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time work off-campus is strictly restricted during the first semester and requires university and immigration permission thereafter.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; graduates are eligible for Korean job-seeking visas (D-10) and skilled professional work visas (E-7) in the Korean tech sector.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Obligation to fulfill designated laboratory research duties (BK21/NRF project deliverables).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding terminated if student leaves laboratory without permission, withdraws, or fails academic standing.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from supervising professor and Department Chair.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding extends through standard degree duration (2 years MSc, 3-4 years PhD); extensions subject to professor grant funding.
